name: Chip
description: A framework-free Web Component that styles a compact token and lets the author keep the semantics that match how the chip behaves.

variants.name: Static
variants.description: A plain token that presents information and stays out of the tab order.

variants.name: Removable
variants.description: A token with its own remove button, named after the chip and reachable by keyboard.

variants.name: Action
variants.description: Chips that act, shown as a real button and as a real link so each keeps its own behavior.

variants.name: Filter
variants.description: Toggle chips that report their state through aria-pressed rather than colour alone.

variants.name: Adorned
variants.description: Chips carrying a leading avatar or icon and a trailing count beside the label.

variants.name: Appearance
variants.description: Every combination of filled and outlined across the five intents and both sizes.
